# Utility node kinds with no executor deployed

Three node kinds ship in the image and run in-process. A template using them
needs no executor block, no service containers, and no `executor:` on any node.

## Run the deployment on its defaults

```bash
docker run -d -p 8080:8080 rimsky-all-in-one:<tag>
```

No mounted configuration.

```bash
curl -sS "$BASE/v1/observability/executors"
```

Every executor the deployment knows about answers at an `inproc://` address.
None is reachable at a service address.

## The template

```yaml
name: utility-kinds-demo
version: "1"
messages:
  - type: util/ping
    body_schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        value: {type: integer}
      required: [value]
nodes:
  - type: counter
    kind: loop_counter
    attributes:
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          max:   {type: integer, default: 1}
          count: {type: integer}

  - type: sender
    sends_message: util/ping
    subscribes:
      - node: counter
        type: terminal/success
        force_upstream_refresh: false
      - node: counter
        type: attribute/count/changed
        force_upstream_refresh: false
    attributes:
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          value: {type: integer, source: "{{nodes.counter.attribute.count}}"}
        required: [value]

  - type: receiver
    kind: attribute_passthrough
    subscribes:
      - node: util/ping
        type: terminal/success
        force_upstream_refresh: false
    attributes:
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          got: {type: integer, source: "{{messages.util/ping.value}}"}
```

The three bundled utility kinds are `loop_counter`, `attribute_passthrough`, and
`send_message` — the last reached by declaring `sends_message` on a node.

## Drive it

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "$BASE/v1/instances/$IID/messages" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" -d '{}'

curl -sS "$BASE/v1/observability/events?instance_id=$IID&limit=500"
curl -sS "$BASE/v1/instances/$IID/messages"
```

## What the product does

All three kinds dispatch exactly once and settle `terminal/success`.

The loop counter emits `{"count": 1}`. The send node puts one `util/ping`
message in the ledger. The passthrough receiver carries that message's body into
its own output attributes as `{"got": 1}`.

One template, three kinds, no deployment beyond the stack itself.
